text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Teio!! You looked so cool 
out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I became your fan after today's race! Good 
luck next time too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, leave it to me! Because this 
victory is—

Saying that, Tokai Teio raised her index 
finger toward the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's the first crown!! I'm gonna win the 
next one too and become a Triple Crown 
Umamusume~!

The next day, as requested by Tokai Teio, 
we decided to train without taking a 
break.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do our best in training 
today too~! I wanna do that thing 
again—tandem running!
choice_data_list:
You must still be feeling the fatigue from 
the race, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, really! You worry way too 
much, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you can't just be taking it easy, 
you know? Do you know what your next 
target race is?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a race every Umamusume 
absoluuutely wants to win, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, everyone's bound to 
give it their absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I've gotta try super-duper hard too! 
Way, waaay more than during the Satsuki 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, I'm off to do some tandem 
training! The second crown is as good as 
mine~!

Tokai Teio practically forced the issue 
and went off for her tandem training.

And so, without a moment's rest, training 
for the Japanese Derby began.
